newsitem.title: USA: Aksys Ltd Q1 loss widens as expenses climb.
newsitem.headline: Aksys Ltd Q1 loss widens as expenses climb.

text.p: Aksys Ltd said Tuesday higher research and development spending, new hires and infrastructure expenditures contributed to a higher loss in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company, which is developing hemodialysis products and services for patients suffering from kidney failure, said it lost $3.5 million, or $0.25 a share, compared to a loss of $1.9 million, or $0.18, a year ago.
As a developing company, Aksys did not have any revenues in the first quarter of either 1997 or 1996.
Company officials said Aksys continues to make progress toward clinical trials of its products, currently planned for the fourth quarter of 1997.
Aksys shares were off 3/8 Tuesday at 8-1/4.
